With regard to certificates already issued, the FAA will suspend an individual’s airman certificates after receiving the Initial Notification of Threat Assessment from the TSA. Suspension is appropriate in this circumstance, because the TSA’s initial assessment that an individual poses a security threat is still subject to review by the TSA’s Deputy Administrator and may be reversed. If at this point a U.S. citizen is still determined a threat, TSA’s Under Secretary will make the final determination. If a Final Notification of Threat Assessment is issued, the FAA will revoke the certificates; if an Initial Notification is withdrawn, the FAA will withdraw its certificate suspension.
